investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell command created a Run registry entry to persistently launch C:\ProgramData\winupd.ps1 via a hidden PowerShell process. Correlated events show the same host previously downloaded winupd.ps1 from 91.214.88.109 and then executed it, indicating external retrieval plus persistence. An IP reputation check failed due to a server error and no VirusTotal data is available for the spawning process, so external reputation could not be validated. Because this sequence includes an external download and registry persistence on a server and is not consistent with routine maintenance, the activity is considered High Priority.
